 Putnam County to be in national spotlight tonight
 November 13, 2026 
 5:38 am 
 Mid-Hudson News Staff 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Email 
 Print 
 TV set. MHNN file photo 
 CARMEL – Millions of residents across the United States will learn about Putnam County this evening when ABC television’s 20/20 program investigates two cases involving schoolgirls from Carmel. 
 “Hiding Beneath the Surface: The Putnam County School Girls,” investigates the 1994 disappearance and murder of 12-year-old Josette Wright and the unresolved disappearance of 17-year-old Robin Murphy in April 1995. 
 Their disappearances occurred six months apart, raising questions about whether the cases could be connected and whether someone within the community possessed information about what happened. 
 Josette disappeared in October 1994. Her remains were discovered in a wooded area a year later. Two men, Anthony DiPippo and Andrew Krivak, were convicted of her murder in 1997, but both convictions were overturned following years of legal challenges. DiPippo was acquitted at a retrial in 2016, while Krivak was acquitted in February 2023. 
 The investigations became connected through questions about possible suspects. 
 The 20/20 program examines the lives of both girls, the original police investigations, disputed witness testimony, allegations of coerced confessions, the collapse of two murder convictions and the unanswered questions that continue to surround both cases. 
 Mid-Hudson News’ Putnam County reporter Eric Gross was interviewed for the program and his testimony has been included in the program that will be aired from 9-11 p.m.
